evidenceClass: Production File API and IndexedDB in local Chromium with a synthetic paged R2 REST listing

methodology.cold: A new database and search owner for each sample. Record first response and total time to real completion or explicit limits.
methodology.warm: Restart the inventory and search owner with the last saved IndexedDB, then rotate independent substring queries.
methodology.partitioned: Generate pages on demand for the specified 10,000-child directory in the synthetic million-entry bucket. No recursive listing.
methodology.flatCapacity: Use the released cache and scan limits. Incomplete searches are measured without treating an unseen late hit as absent.
methodology.storage: Chromium isolated-origin quota usage estimate after the last cold fill; this includes IndexedDB allocation overhead.
methodology.memory: Chromium JS heap sampled every 5 ms during each operation; renderer-only estimate excludes the browser database process and brief unsampled peaks.
methodology.avoided: The number of provider calls a complete re-list would require for the exact directory, minus measured warm provider calls. No live R2 latency is inferred.
